reviews.review: All the negative reviews are just people that aint ready to grind. The game is very hard at first (even on normal). The really fun part of all of it is that you gain the rune juice over time allowing you to upgrade your character stats across all runs. I have maxed out all the juice power ups and I am now an unstoppable force in normal mode. It is fun to see how powerful you can get. You learn what specific powerups are the best for you too as you play. I have also done hard mode as every character and it is a challenge but in the end I was able to do it. With friends and solo I enjoy this game. Yes, there is not a lot here right now, but it is EA and I can see the care that has gone into it. There are lot of details and references to find to real world things. Before you look at those negative reviews as the truth, look at how many hours they have played because that will tell you what you need to know.
reviews.developer_response: Thanks for the review! We hope you'll dig the August update.

reviews.review: Pretty fun but there are still things to work on. It feels like weapons play bigger part than any powerups so unless u have better weapon u get cooked. Still hope they work on the feel of the game and make it better so i can happily return and enjoy it for longer time.
